newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says was willing to help stabilise baht.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says was willing to help stabilise baht.

text.p: Indonesian central bank governor Sudradjat Djiwandono has said that Indonesia was willing to help stabilise the Thai baht when it was hit by a fierce speculative attack last week, the official Antara news agency reported.
Antara quoted Djiwandono, the governor of Bank Indonesia, as saying that Indonesian authorities had notified Thai counterparts of their intention to help stabilise the baht on Saturday.
"But before we could take action, the baht returned to normal," he was quoted as saying.
Djiwandono said Thailand and Indonesia had a bilateral agreement to help each other's currencies in times of crisis and that Jakarta remained committed to the pact.
